blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Provides all-in-one solution for slow aging, skin glow, elasticity, and moisturizing.
Provides non-oily real volumizing glow that removes any prejudice on ampoule spray.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: After shaking well to mix the water and oil layers thoroughly, close your eyes and spray evenly over your entire face from adistance of 4 to 8 inches from the skin. Let it absorb into the skin.

blocks.label: Warnings

Read instructions and caution before use.
